speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: asked	the Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (a) what are the criteria for the disbursement of the Opportunity Fund Grant to schools, including the polytechnics; (b) what type of co-curricular activities are covered by this Fund; and (c) to date, what is the number of students who have benefited from this Fund.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
text: The Scheme seeks to create opportunities for such students to access learning opportunities which they would otherwise miss out on due to their family circumstances.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
text: This top-up rate ensures that schools with larger numbers of needy students are provided with more funds to help these students.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
text: On average, a primary school receives about $30,000, whilst a secondary school receives about $44,000.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
text: As explained earlier, the grant will be higher if the school has a relatively higher proportion of FAS recipients.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
text: Similarly, the grant to ITE and polytechnics is determined by the number of students and FAS profiles.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
text: Beyond these three broad areas, MOE does not specify the programmes for which the Opportunity Fund can be used.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
text: Schools and institutions have the flexibility to identify these programmes and decide on which students can benefit, taking into account the profile of their students.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
text: The Opportunity Fund has been welcomed and well-used by schools and institutions.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
text: Students, particularly those on FAS, are able to benefit from the enrichment programmes and other areas supported by Opportunity Fund.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
text: In light of the fact that Opportunity Fund is meant to assist students from needy families, the intent is really just to increase social mobility.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
text: Can I just check how these funds are disbursed in the schools?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
text: Do the students apply or the schools assign the amounts that are given to the students?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
text: What is the utilisation rate by the schools of this Fund?
